title: My Members > Member Categories > How to Import Categories via CSV File

sections.heading: Category Structure Overview
sections.content:
Brilliant Directories supports a 3-tier category hierarchy:
1. Top-Level Category (e.g. Healthcare, Legal, Home Services)
2. Sub-Category (e.g. Dentistry, Cardiology)
3. Sub-Sub-Category (e.g. Pediatric Dentistry, Orthodontics)
Each member can be assigned 1 Top-Level category and multiple Sub or Sub-Sub categories.

sections.heading: Importing Categories with CSV
sections.content:
1. Go to My Members > Member Categories.
2. Click the orange 'Import Categories' button at the top right.
3. Download the Sample CSV Template to ensure correct column headers: 'Top Level Category', 'Sub Level Category', and 'Sub-Sub Level Category'.
4. Upload your prepared CSV file. BD will automatically deduplicate and create the parent-child relationships.
